0022600035.text: The Orlando Magic (3-7, 11th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 3 games back) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-10, 15th in the East) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, with Orlando winless at home at 0-4 and Milwaukee on a seven-game losing streak. Orlando is on a one-game winning streak after going 3-3 on the road, and Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jamal Cain, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Tristan da Silva and Izaiyah Nelson are all listed as out for the Magic, while Myles Turner is out for Milwaukee due to rest. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Magic won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 130-91 win in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026.
